formalSpecification.name: Music_Studio_最終機能仕様書_v1.pdf
formalSpecification.read: Re-read current original on 2026-10-19 JST, pages 1–5 /166 lines; modified 2026-09-30.

scope: Resumable full-song bar checkpoints, explicit durable save/reopen/backup, strict source/settings/model validation and cooperative server cancellation. No complete-feature closure.
